## MultipleSequenceAlignmentProps.onRenameRow property

Enables inline rename of a row label (double-click, or the pencil on hover). The component never edits `msa` itself: apply the rename to your data (or edit log) and pass it back.

**Signature:**

```typescript
onRenameRow?: (rowId: string, name: string) => void;
```
